title: Responsible Machine Learning knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Responsible Machine Learning”?
options: Responsible Machine Learning is part of Troubleshooting, Testing, and Professional Practices. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions.
The method proves that every prediction will be correct on all future datasets.
The method removes the need to inspect data quality or define an evaluation strategy.
The method always performs better than a simple baseline, regardless of the task.
questions.answer_key: Responsible Machine Learning is part of Troubleshooting, Testing, and Professional Practices. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions.
questions.explanation: The lesson frames the topic this way: Responsible Machine Learning is part of Troubleshooting, Testing, and Professional Practices. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions. The other options make unsupported guarantees.

questions.prompt: What is a sound first step when applying “Responsible Machine Learning” to a new task?
options: Tune against the final test set until the preferred metric increases.
Remove records that produce unexpected outcomes without investigating them.
Assume the default parameters are best for every dataset.
Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Representativeness of training data; then test it on representative data.
questions.answer_key: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Representativeness of training data; then test it on representative data.
questions.explanation: Define the input, output, assumptions, and evidence needed. For Representativeness of training data, a small representative check is more useful than blind tuning.

questions.prompt: What conclusion is appropriately cautious after trying “Responsible Machine Learning”?
options: A higher training score alone proves generalization to unseen data.
An internal estimator score replaces domain review and operational monitoring.
A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
A single successful run proves fairness, robustness, and production readiness.
questions.answer_key: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.explanation: A demonstration only supports conclusions within its scope. Evaluate representative unseen cases and report limitations before production use.
